_about: Decision rules for the data-engineer-h1b sponsor-screen prototype. Every value here is a chosen rule, not a record. Provenance per block in _source. Changing a value here changes outcomes: log the change in CHANGE-BRIEF.md's revisions.

family_patterns._source: model-judgment (title family proposed by Claude, accepted by the author 2026-10-03)

exclusion_patterns._source: model-judgment (wrong level or different job for a new-grad Data Engineer). v0.5.0 added 'account executive' and 'sales' after discovery on 2026-10-20 matched 'Account Executive, Product Sales (Data Pipeline)' at Stripe through the 'data pipeline' pattern

tiers._source: model-judgment (rule proposed by Claude; p values copy the tier values in data/examples/ch11-roles.json)

sponsorship_source_label._source: your-input (author's decision 2026-10-03: the score is Claude's rule applied to records, so it is labelled model-judgment)

liveness._source: your-input (a liveness check older than this is treated as stale)

name_suffixes._source: your-input (legal-form words removed before exact name matching)

aliases._source: your-input (v0.5.0: an alias in aliases.json is used only after a person has reviewed it; an unreviewed alias is reported as alias-pending-review, with the record it would match, and the row stays unscored)

posting_age._source: your-input (v0.5.0: a posting whose Greenhouse first_published date is older than this is flagged as possibly evergreen. A flag for the person, not a gate and not a score term: age alone does not prove a job is not being filled)

fit_floor._source: your-input (author's decision 2026-10-20, closing the [TODO: DEFINE]: for a Proven sponsor, sponsorship alone (0.9 x 0.35 = 0.315) clears the scorer's 0.3 Apply line, so fit could never lower an Apply. Below this fit the result is capped at Consider. Applied after the scorer; it can only lower a result, never raise one)
